deficit-deadlift.criteria: Stand on a low stable platform, hold the bar outside the legs, extend knees and hips to stand, lower plates to the ground under control. Platform supports the feet, not the plates.

limits: Procedural 3D demonstration, not captured motion. Eight-second illustrative cycle. Platform height is a model-space choice. Sampled lower-body surface distances are not full-mesh collision or biomechanical certification. Production and physical-device validation pending.
